answer: The zenith of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Each submission hangs on the crystal of a task receipt, and the walnut is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, released only after three unrelated confirmations, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
